answer.text: For tracks not specifically listed in the Michelin Preco documents, the specifications for 'low stress circuit standard' must be used.
Alternatively, users may apply the STANDARD recommendations for use as a general fallback for all other tracks not explicitly listed in mid stress and high stress categories.
For tracks with banking other than those listed, users must contact their Michelin Technical Advisor for specific recommendations.

For tracks with banking other than those listed, users must contact their Michelin Technical Advisor for specific recommendations [E3].
